Australian house prices decline amid economic pressures

Australian house prices have seen a decline across major cities including Brisbane, Adelaide, and Perth. The nation's median home price has fallen approximately $19,000 below its March peak. This downturn is attributed to factors such as the Middle East conflict and changes in tax policies. Data from Cotality indicates the market retreat is accelerating.
